units.source: Drawing shapes
units.context: Drawing shapes

units.source: The following shapes can be drawn on the map: a path, an area, a rectangle or a circle.
units.context: Drawing shapes

units.source: Unlike markers, the title of the shape is not displayed directly on the map but it will be displayed when hovered.
units.context: Drawing shapes

units.source: The shape will also be drawn in the __TRILIUM_PH_0__color of the note__TRILIUM_PH_1__, if set.
units.context: Drawing shapes

units.source: Drawing a shape on the map__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map

units.source: To draw a shape, use the toolbar that appears in the top-center area on desktop and on the left-center on mobile and in split view.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map

units.source: Once a shape is drawn, it cannot be moved or modified. To do so, simply remove the shape and draw another one instead.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map

units.source: Drawing a path or an area__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a path or an area

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Draw a path on the map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (__TRILIUM_PH_2__) or __TRILIUM_PH_3__Draw an area on the map__TRILIUM_PH_4__ (__TRILIUM_PH_5__) button. The button stays held down while the tool is armed, and a notification describes what to do.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a path or an area

units.source: Click on the map once for each point. The shape is previewed as it grows.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a path or an area

units.source: Finish it by pressing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_1__. A path can also be finished by clicking its last point again, and an area by clicking the corner it started from. A path needs at least two points and an area at least three.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a path or an area

units.source: Drawing a rectangle or a circle__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a rectangle or a circle

units.source: Press the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Draw a rectangle on the map__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (__TRILIUM_PH_2__) or __TRILIUM_PH_3__Draw a circle on the map__TRILIUM_PH_4__ (__TRILIUM_PH_5__) button.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a rectangle or a circle

units.source: Click once to set the first corner, or the center of the circle. Click a second time at the opposite corner, or at the distance the circle should reach.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a rectangle or a circle

units.source: Instead of two clicks you can drag from one to the other. This also works on mobile and other touch-based apps.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Drawing a rectangle or a circle

units.source: Finishing and cancelling__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Finishing and cancelling

units.source: To give up on a shape while drawing it, press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Escape__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or press the tool's button again. Whatever has been drawn so far is discarded.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Finishing and cancelling

units.source: The tool is deactivated once a shape is finished, so drawing a second shape requires another button press.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Drawing a shape on the map > Finishing and cancelling

units.source: Interaction__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: Once a shape is created:
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: Clicking a shape opens the standard panel which allows changing the title, the content and with buttons to open the note or remove it.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: When clicking, a marker takes priority over the shape.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: Right-clicking a shape opens a contextual menu similar to the one for markers, which allows opening the corresponding note or removing the shape.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: Typing in the map's search bar finds shapes by their title, as it does markers. Selecting one brings the whole shape into view.
units.context: Drawing shapes > Interaction

units.source: How shapes are represented__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: Drawing shapes > How shapes are represented

units.source: Shapes are represented quite similarly to markers, which means each shape is a note. The information about the same is stored using a __TRILIUM_PH_0__label__TRILIUM_PH_1__ called __TRILIUM_PH_2__.
units.context: Drawing shapes > How shapes are represented
